messages:
elena: Heads-up: noticed several orgs showing $0 (and some NaN) on the Token Cost widget after last night's billing backfill. Affected orgs: org-8723, org-9901. Shown totals are wrong in the last 24h. Anyone else seeing this? @samir

samir: I see the spike in support alerts. Can you paste the dashboard link + the org ids? I'll start looking into the aggregation and API responses.

elena: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/org-8723/costs (example). Backfill finished ~2026-03-16T02:15Z. UI shows $0 for those orgs, and some queries return null/NaN.

billing-bot: Backfill job complete: job_id=bf-2026-03-16 status=success rows_processed=12345 error_count=0 (logged 2026-03-16T02:16:03Z)

infra-bot: Ingest pipeline transient S3 read errors between 01:58-02:03 UTC. Retries succeeded; some partial batches were reprocessed. (see logs /infra/ingest/2026-03-16)

jordan: billing-team here. My hypothesis: the backfill wrote rows with cost=NULL for SKUs where price_lookup join failed, and downstream aggregator didn't coalesce nulls. That can result in NULL totals which the frontend formatter turns into 0 or NaN. I'll check ledger joins.

mia: I ran a quick repro query against the warehouse. Example:```
SELECT org_id, SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM billing_events
WHERE org_id IN ('org-8723','org-9901')
GROUP BY org_id;
```Result: org-8723 -> 125.40, org-9901 -> NULL

mia: Looks like price_lookup missing entries for certain skus. Here's the aggregation I tested:```
SELECT be.org_id, SUM(COALESCE(be.cost, pr.price * be.units)) AS total
FROM billing_events be
LEFT JOIN price_lookup pr ON be.sku = pr.sku
WHERE be.org_id IN ('org-8723','org-9901')
GROUP BY be.org_id;
```This returns a numeric for both orgs when price exists; returns NULL when price_lookup is missing.

samir: Reproduced locally against staging snapshot. API /api/metrics/costs?org=org-9901 returns JSON {"total": null} and frontend currency formatter interprets null -> 0. Steps to reproduce: 1) run mia's query to create NULL totals; 2) call metrics API; 3) observe UI shows $0. Fix: frontend should handle null as missing (render '—') and aggregator should COALESCE to 0 or derive from price * units. I'll open a quick frontend PR and coordinate backfill. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/webapp/pull/5678 (draft)

elena: Can you outline repro steps so support can respond to customers?

samir: Repro steps for support: 1) run the aggregation query above; 2) curl https://api.redwood.ai/internal/metrics/costs?org=ORG_ID (auth token) -> check the "total" field; 3) if total is null, customer will see $0 in widget. I'll add this to the incident note.

jordan: Remediation plan: 1) quick SQL patch in nightly aggregator: SUM(COALESCE(cost, price * units, 0)) 2) schedule targeted backfill for the affected orgs/sku combinations (RG-321) 3) frontend change to not map null->0. I'll create the backfill job and notify ops.

mia: Pushing a staging aggregator change now (test included). Also adding a unit test to catch NULL totals. SQL diff: replace `SUM(cost)` -> `SUM(COALESCE(cost, price * units, 0))`.

elena: Support action: please notify affected customers with ETA ~4h and link this thread. Label: P2-billing-dashboard.

samir: Assigned: frontend fix -> @samir, aggregator/backfill -> @mia + @jordan. I'll post updates here as actions complete. Thanks all :thumbsup:
